suppress.notes: CVE-2025-22228 is mitigated in the application's bcrypt wrapper, not patched in the library. PasswordSecurity delegates bcrypt hashes to sk.iway.iwcm.users.crypto.Bcrypt, which returns false for passwords longer than 72 UTF-8 bytes before BCrypt.checkpw. This applies to arbitrary prefixes, multibyte characters, and direct wrapper calls. Authentication uses the existing generic invalid-password response. Hash creation is unchanged and no migration is performed; overlong passwords, including newly saved ones, fail verification when entered in full and require a password reset. Regression tests cover the byte boundary, common-prefix collisions, and legacy SHA-512. Reassess if authentication or hashing bypasses this wrapper or the dependency changes. https://spring.io/security/cve-2025-22228/

CVE-2026-41855 requires Jackson JMS message converters processing untrusted JMS messages. The scanned runtime dependencies contain no spring-jms module, and the application does not configure MappingJackson2MessageConverter, JacksonJsonMessageConverter, or JMS listeners. The report matches the generic Spring Framework CPE to the modules listed below. Reassess if a project adds Spring JMS integration. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41855/

CVE-2026-47884 requires XsltView together with a catch-all mapping and an implicit view name. WebjetComponentSpringConfig configures JSP, FreeMarker, and Thymeleaf view resolvers. No XsltView or XsltViewResolver is configured in this application. Reassess if a project adds an XSLT view resolver. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/

CVE-2026-47891 requires Spring WebFlux XML input decoding with the Aalto XML processor. This application uses servlet Spring MVC; the scanned runtime dependencies contain neither spring-webflux nor aalto-xml, and no reactive XML decoder is configured. Reassess if a project adds WebFlux XML processing. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47891/

CVE-2026-47892 requires functional web endpoints and their header predicates. This application uses annotated servlet MVC controllers. No RouterFunction or RouterFunctions configuration was found, and spring-webflux is absent from the scanned runtime dependencies. Reassess if a project adds functional web routes. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47892/

CVE-2026-59313 requires Spring MVC functional routes using ServerResponse.sse() to stream attacker-controlled plain text. No MVC functional routes or ServerResponse.sse() calls are present. AssistantController streams through HttpServletResponse and BufferedWriter instead. Reassess if a project adds functional SSE endpoints. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59313/

CVE-2026-59270 requires an embedded LDAP server started through UnboundIdContainer. The scanned runtime dependencies contain neither spring-security-ldap nor the UnboundID SDK, and there is no UnboundIdContainer or spring.ldap.embedded configuration. WebJET LDAP authentication uses JNDI InitialDirContext as a client of an external LDAP server. Reassess if a project adds an embedded LDAP server. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59270/

CVE-2026-22732 was reviewed for the 2026.0 hotfix configuration on 2026-10-08. This is an application-specific mitigation and accepted-risk suppression, not a library fix or proof that every possible execution path is unaffected. WebJET writes its own security headers in SetCharacterEncodingFilter.setCommonHeaders(), and PathFilter.setStaticContentHeaders()/setCacheHeaders() manage applicable cache policies. This Spring defect does not remove headers that WebJET has already written. GetProtectedFileServlet calls PathFilter.setNoCacheHeaders() before sending protected files, explicitly setting Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0, Pragma, and Expires for full, range, and conditional responses, replacing earlier cache policies. MultipartFileSender uses setContentLengthLong() for full and single-range responses so Spring Security tracks the response length and writes its headers before commitment. Other response-writing paths must still be assessed separately. Keep default lazy header writing to preserve existing cache and response.reset() behavior. Reassess if response-writing code, header ownership, or proxy/CDN cache policies change, or if a request demonstrates missing cache protection on a sensitive response. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-22732/

CVE-2026-59283 requires active SpEL expression compilation. WebjetComponentSpringConfig disables the Thymeleaf SpEL compiler. SpringAppInitializer sets spring.expression.compiler.mode=OFF through SpringProperties during class initialization, before creating the application context and default parsers, including Spring Data binding. Reassess if a project enables the Thymeleaf compiler, overrides Spring properties, or constructs a SpelParserConfiguration with IMMEDIATE or MIXED compilation. This is a configuration mitigation, not a patched Spring Framework binary. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59283/

CVE-2026-116804 (GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7) requires SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES together with RETURN_DOM, RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT, or IN_PLACE and DOM input carrying a shadow root. File: src/main/webapp/admin/swagger-ui/swagger-ui-bundle.js (matched by SHA-1 below). Swagger UI 5.34.0 uses DOMPurify 3.4.16 only to sanitize Markdown-rendered HTML strings and returns strings. Its sanitizer does not enable any of these options, and its only DOMPurify hook adds rel="noopener noreferrer" to links. This is non-applicability for this exact bundle, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, sanitizer options, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7

CVE-2026-17495 requires server-side npm Moment and attacker-controlled non-string input to moment.locale(). WebJET uses Moment in the browser; app-init.js passes the language string window.userLng. There is no server-side locale input path. Reassess if Moment is used in Node.js request processing or locale loading changes. https://github.com/moment/moment/security/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw

GHSA-g2v6-rqmx-r4w6 affects Vue server-side HTML rendering. The admin application is a browser application mounted via VueTools.createApp; it does not invoke createSSRApp, renderToString, or @vue/server-renderer. The renderer is transitive. Reassess if server-side rendering is introduced or the package version changes. https://github.com/vuejs/core/security/advisories/GHSA-g2v6-rqmx-r4w6

CVE-2026-116803 requires DOMPurify IN_PLACE mode and an application hook that detaches a parent or sibling subtree. Swagger UI 5.34.0 with DOMPurify 3.4.16 sanitizes Markdown-rendered HTML strings without IN_PLACE. Its only DOMPurify hook sets rel="noopener noreferrer" on links and does not detach nodes. This is non-applicability, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, sanitizer options, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr

CVE-2026-116802 requires PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE="application/xhtml+xml" and an allowlist enabling SVG animation elements and attributeName. Swagger UI 5.34.0 with DOMPurify 3.4.16 sanitizes Markdown-rendered HTML strings using the default text/html parser. Its sanitizer only sets ADD_ATTR=["target"], FORBID_TAGS, ALLOW_DATA_ATTR, and FORBID_ATTR; it does not enable XHTML or SVG animation. File: src/main/webapp/admin/swagger-ui/swagger-ui-bundle.js (matched by SHA-1). This is non-applicability for this exact bundle, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, parser mode, allowlists, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f

CVE-2026-75140 is incorrectly attributed to jsoup 1.17.2. The vulnerable XML implementation copies the inherited namespace map for each nested element. XmlTreeBuilder in the resolved 1.17.2 JAR and upstream 1.17.2 source has no namespacesStack or inherited namespace-map copying. The affected implementation was added later. This exception covers only this CVE and this exact version. Reassess on a jsoup version change; other jsoup findings remain unsuppressed. https://github.com/jhy/jsoup/blob/jsoup-1.17.2/src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/XmlTreeBuilder.java https://github.com/jhy/jsoup/commit/862ba2f1d48ee95609183dbcfc848c9fd7afc76a

CVE-2026-104828 affects HTMLWriterFilter serialization of TITLE and TEXTAREA. WebJET DocTools uses DaisyDiff HtmlCleaner, whose NekoHtmlParser parses through SAXParser into ContentHandler handlers and DomTreeBuilder, not HTMLWriterFilter. The resolved wjdaisydiff bytecode and runtime JAR references were inspected; no consumer of HTMLWriterFilter is present. The parser itself is not the vulnerable serializer. Reassess if the diff pipeline or Neko usage changes, especially if HTMLWriterFilter is introduced by application code or dependencies. https://github.com/HtmlUnit/htmlunit-neko/security/advisories/GHSA-39xg-prhf-8785

CVE-2026-41838 requires Spring WebSocket, CVE-2026-47888 requires RSocket, and CVE-2026-47893 requires WebFlux WebSocket handling. The resolved WebJET runtime has no spring-websocket, spring-messaging, spring-webflux, or RSocket implementation. Springfox's documentation adapter is not Spring WebFlux. These findings are repeated across unrelated Spring Framework modules. Reassess if these runtime modules or corresponding features are introduced, including by a customer installation. Scope is limited to inspected artifacts. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41838/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47888/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47893/

CVE-2026-47838 requires X.509 authentication with SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor. CVE-2026-40988 requires SAML2 authentication. SpringSecurityConf configures the WebJET authentication provider and optional HTTP Basic, not X.509 or SAML2; the resolved runtime also lacks spring-security-saml2-service-provider. Reassess if a customer SpringConfig enables either authentication mechanism or authentication dependencies/configuration change. This is non-applicability for the inspected product configuration, not a Spring Security library patch. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47838/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-40988/

CVE-2026-41842 requires versioned filesystem resources served through Spring's resource handling. BaseSpringConfig enables default servlet handling and does not register a versioned resource chain or VersionResourceResolver. No other product configuration registers this feature. WebJET's own cache-version URL handling does not enable Spring resource versioning. Reassess if a customer WebMvcConfigurer or other configuration adds versioned Spring filesystem resources. Scope is the inspected 5.3.39 artifact set. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41842/

CVE-2026-41848 requires an attacker-controlled pattern passed to AntPathMatcher, not merely an attacker-controlled request path. Product routing/security patterns are supplied by application code/configuration; BaseSpringConfig uses fixed request matchers. No product endpoint supplies untrusted matcher patterns. Reassess if custom controllers/configuration expose pattern input to AntPathMatcher or if routing/security pattern construction changes. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41848/

CVE-2026-41721 requires Spring Data Web Support together with @ProjectedPayload. V9SpringConfig enables Spring Data Web Support, but the product has no @ProjectedPayload request projections. Pageable and normal DTO binding alone do not satisfy this advisory's prerequisites. Reassess if product or customer controllers introduce @ProjectedPayload. This exception does not cover the other Spring Data property-path findings. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41721/
